items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 161:1
items.html: And one must understand well the matter of the three worlds BYA, for on the one hand we say that they are the posterior of YESHSUT and ZON, that Beriah is of the coarseness of phase two, Yetzirah is of the coarseness of phase three, and Assiyah is of the coarseness of phase four. And on the other hand we say that the world of Beriah came out on a screen of phase two, Yetzirah on a screen of phase one, and Assiyah on a screen of the aspect of a root. Which, at first glance, contradict one another.
